import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
from category_encoders import OneHotEncoder

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

# Save original dtypes for later restoration
train_dtypes = train_df.dtypes.copy()

# Get feature columns excluding Id and target using consistent logic
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]

# Create consistent feature matrix from training data
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["Cover_Type"]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()
test_ids = test_df["Id"].values.copy()

# Convert categorical columns to object type for better handling
for col in feature_cols:
    X_train[col] = X_train[col].astype(str)
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].astype(str)

# Train/val split BEFORE training
X_train_final, X_valid, y_train_final, y_valid = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Handle any missing values
X_train_final.dropna(inplace=True)
X_valid.dropna(inplace=True)
X_test.dropna(inplace=True)

# Initialize LightGBM classifier with better defaults
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=-1,
    num_leaves=31,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
    force_col_wise=True,
)

# Train ONLY on training data (not touching validation set)
model.fit(X_train_final, y_train_final)

# Compute validation accuracy on truly held-out data
val_pred = model.predict(X_valid)
validation_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_valid, val_pred)

# Predict on test set
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission dataframe
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": test_pred.astype(int)})

# Save to correct location
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Print only the accuracy metric
print(validation_accuracy)
